hero.title: The AI-native development workspace for the whole team
hero.subtitle: Think VS Code, but equally approachable for business teams and developers. PromptConnext orchestrates the AI models you already pay for and carries a project from business requirement to running code — transparently, at every step.
hero.note: Free for the desktop app · macOS, Windows · No signup required

threeS.title: Scope → Spec → Skill
threeS.description: One guided flow takes a project from a business idea to shipping code. Each stage has a clear approval gate, so nothing moves forward before it's ready.
threeS.scopeDesc: Describe what the project should achieve in business terms. PromptConnext turns it into a structured specification — no CLI, no jargon.
threeS.specDesc: Review and approve the generated plan as the project spec. Business and tech lead see the same truth before a line of code is written.
threeS.skillDesc: The tech lead equips the project with models, agents, and MCP servers, then implementation proceeds — all traceable in one graph.

dual.title: Business intent and technical execution, side by side
dual.description: Business users define scope, review plans, and approve specs — never touching a CLI. Developers continue in the same project with full control over models, agents, and settings. Both watch the same live progress.
dual.businessDesc: Requirements, plan review, spec approval, and live delivery progress — in plain language.
dual.devDesc: Models, MCP servers, coding settings, the execution graph, and code artifacts — under your control.

byo.title: Connect your own models and keys — cloud or local
byo.description: PromptConnext is the orchestration layer, not a proprietary model. Connect the AI you already have and route each task to the model best suited to it.
byo.f1Title: Connect what you already pay for
byo.f1Desc: API keys or OpenAI-compatible endpoints — OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, OpenRouter, and more. No PromptConnext model tax.
byo.f2Desc: Point PromptConnext at Ollama and run a capable model on your own machine. A privacy-safe path that costs nothing.
byo.f3Desc: Bring Claude Code, Gemini CLI, or a custom agent. PromptConnext provides the workspace, task, and context — you keep control.
byo.honesty: A note on honesty: a consumer chat subscription (like ChatGPT Plus) is not the same as API access, which is billed separately. PromptConnext supports API keys, local models, and agentic sign-in where providers allow it — we’ll always tell you which mode you’re using.

transparency.title: Every step, traceable end to end
transparency.description: Requirements, specs, tasks, artifacts, and agent runs all live in one graph. Nothing about how your software got built is a black box — and your code and keys never leave your machine.

integrations.title: Works with the tools you already use
integrations.description: Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex CLI, Ollama, MCP servers, and Jira/ClickUp sync.
